summary: Frontend-only Playwright test of Slipstream (Expo Web) at mobile 375x667 after fresh localStorage.clear(). All acceptance checks pass: HOME renders with all six testIDs (home-bike-name shows 'Street 250 ›', home-ride/garage/shop/prestige/leaderboard-button). Nav home-shop-button opens /shop with three tabs (shop-tab-bikes/rider/paint) that switch content; shop-preview shows the rider; all six shop-bike-<id> cards render; buying unowned Sport RR with 0 coins triggers 'Need 1,200 coins' toast and does NOT select it; street bike buy button shows ✓ (selected). Rider tab: rookie shows ✓; tapping shop-char-buy-racer with 0 coins shows 'Need 700 coins'. Paint tab: 8 bike swatches; clicking paint-bikeColor-#FF5A5F, paint-helmetColor-#FF5A5F, paint-outfitColor-#2F9BE0 all mark active swatch with ✓ and update the shop-preview colors instantly (verified via screenshot). Leaderboard (empty): leaderboard-best + leaderboard-empty + leaderboard-ride-button all visible on fresh save. RUN: run-start-button starts the run, run-play-area + run-player render, and after ~14–17s of no input the player crashes → run-player-dead sprite appears and run-summary overlay appears ~950ms later with score, distance, combo, crates and +coins line; run-retry-button, run-home-button, run-garage-button all present. No red-screen and zero pageerror/console.error events captured across all navigations. Deprecated packages check: none of expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch are used. Minor: navigating back from /run to / via run-home-button momentarily produced two matching home-ride-button nodes in the DOM (Expo Router keeps previous screen briefly mounted) — non-fatal, just a Playwright locator warning. Cosmetic-only: SLIPSTREAM title still clips slightly on 375px (adjustsFontSizeToFit no-op on RN-Web, same as prior iteration).

issues: SLIPSTREAM title still clips on very narrow widths — adjustsFontSizeToFit is a no-op on RN Web. Cosmetic. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:85-87

action_items: Optional: reduce SLIPSTREAM title fontSize from 44 to ~38 or drop numberOfLines={1} so it never truncates on 320-375px web (adjustsFontSizeToFit is a no-op on RN Web).

Optional: after router.replace('/') from /run, Expo Router leaves the /run tree mounted for a tick causing two home-ride-button nodes momentarily. Not user-visible but flags Playwright locator warnings — consider unmount-on-blur or a small delay.
critical_code_review_comments: shop.tsx: buy handlers correctly gate on state.coins vs def.cost and show precise 'Need N coins' toast — verified with both bike and character.
store.tsx buyBike/buyChar reducers correctly no-op when coins < cost (do NOT modify selection) — matches acceptance criteria.

run.tsx: crash flow (setPhase('crashed') → 950ms delay → showSummary) with run-player-dead rendered from crashX works reliably. coinsForRun is invoked and added via recordRun reducer — leaderboard entry appended via addToLeaderboard.
run.tsx is ~646 lines mixing HUD/overlay/summary/gesture — same as iteration 2, still recommend splitting for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Started fresh — localStorage.clear() before test → 0 coins, 0 tokens, street bike + rookie rider owned/selected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 acceptance items from the review request pass. Paint-tab swatches use testID with hex embedded (e.g. paint-bikeColor-#FF5A5F). Crash requires ~15s of holding lane on 375x667 — fastest way is to not move the player. Post-crash coins are computed via coinsForRun(distance, cratesCollected); with a short run (distance ~200) coinsEarned is small but the leaderboard row still appears. Mocked ads (interstitial) may pop after every 3 runs — dismiss via ad-interstitial-close testID if it blocks flows.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found this iteration.
